name: UiPedia
summary: Directory of design resources plus real-world designer portfolios and a library of design screenshots.
description: A browsable directory of design resources organised into categories with item counts: free and paid courses, jobs, illustrations, AI tools, Figma resources, icons, mockups, gradients and colours, templates, no-code builders, design systems and communities. Alongside it, portfolios of professional designers are filterable by experience, current or previous company and position, and a design screenshot library is aimed at inspiration.
contains: directory of design resources across 20+ categories
category counts: 161 inspirations, 129 illustrations, 100 no-code builders, 80 mockups, 77 AI tools
64 free courses, 22 paid courses and 21 job listings
designer portfolios filterable by experience and current/previous company
